mapper.sql: character_id, user_id, name, level, xp, stage, mood, mood_message, appearance_type, streak_days, best_streak_days, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO characters ( user_id, name, level, xp, stage, mood, mood_message, appearance_type, streak_days, best_streak_days ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{level}, 1), COALESCE(#{xp}, 0), COALESCE(#{stage}, 'EGG'), COALESCE(#{mood}, 'NORMAL'), COALESCE(#{moodMessage}, '냠냠이가 식단 기록과 함께 자랄 준비를 마쳤어요.'), COALESCE(#{appearanceType}, 'NORMAL'), COALESCE(#{streakDays}, 0), COALESCE(#{bestStreakDays}, 0) )
mapper.update: UPDATE characters SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE characters SET level = #{level}, xp = #{xp}, stage = #{stage}, appearance_type = #{appearanceType}, streak_days = #{streakDays}, best_streak_days = #{bestStreakDays}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE character_id = #{characterId}
UPDATE characters SET mood = #{mood}, mood_message = #{moodMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(eaten_at AS DATE) AS record_date FROM diets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE characters SET streak_days = #{streakDays}, best_streak_days = GREATEST(COALESCE(best_streak_days, 0), #{streakDays}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
